Important Dates for General Election

Early Ballot Drop-Off Locations

Ballot drop boxes will remain open through November 2nd at 5:00 pm. On Election day, you may drop off your early ballot at any Vote Center or the Recorder's Office in Bisbee from 6:00 am to 7:00 pm.
